prose.text: The fence runs in this order: 1. host prerequisites; 2. the `conductor-verify` tier; 3. the leg's lint; 4. the round (the operator slot, step 11); 5. the evidence-graded `conductor-run` tier; 6. the workspace gates; 7. supply chain; 8. evidence hygiene; 9. the operator pass.

The `conductor-run` suites sit AFTER the round because the re-round's graded tests read its evidence (step 8). There is no self-verify entry, because no UI changes. The smoke is the mint-then-read `status` of leg F's run id. Every live leg is preceded by the non-priming `preconditions` probe; `pulse-app` itself is launched and stopped by step 11, never by an entry.

The four Pulse slices `evidence/pulse-{h,d,r,f}.jsonl` that assertions 3–6 grade have NO producing entry, by construction. Step 12's byte-copying filter makes them once, after the round, from the pre-leg counts the line-count entry prints and Pulse's post-round log; the source log lives under the operator-supplied data dir and is gone with the slot, so a re-run could only reproduce a different round. Their contents are held by their digest pins (steps 8–9), which the `conductor-run` entries run on every re-run.

cargo nextest run -p conductor-verify --features stub-server --profile ci
PATH="$(realpath ../andromeda-pulse/target/release):$PATH" CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo run -q -p conductor-cli --bin conductor -- preconditions
expect: contains [PRECONDITION] every live-Pulse precondition is satisfied
